segments.ja377:1.1: Mā tāta kujjhi na hi sādhu kodho, bahumpi te adiṭṭhamassutañca;
segments.ja377:1.3: Mātā pitā disatā [disā tāta (syā.), disā tā (pī.)] setaketu, ācariyamāhu disataṃ pasatthā.
segments.ja377:2.1: Agārino annadapānavatthadā [annapānavatthadā (syā. ka.)], avhāyikā tampi disaṃ vadanti;
segments.ja377:2.3: Esā disā paramā setaketu, yaṃ patvā dukkhī sukhino bhavanti.
segments.ja377:3.1: Kharājinā jaṭilā paṅkadantā, dummakkharūpā [dumukkharūpā (sī. syā.), dummukkharūpā (pī. ka.)] yeme jappanti mante;
segments.ja377:3.3: Kacci nu te mānusake payoge, idaṃ vidū parimuttā apāyā.
segments.ja377:4.1: Pāpāni kammāni katvāna rāja, bahussuto ce na [bahussuto neva (sī. syā.)] careyya dhammaṃ;
segments.ja377:4.3: Sahassavedopi na taṃ paṭicca, dukkhā pamuñce caraṇaṃ apatvā.
segments.ja377:5.1: Sahassavedopi na taṃ paṭicca, dukkhā pamuñce caraṇaṃ apatvā;
segments.ja377:5.3: Maññāmi vedā aphalā bhavanti, sasaṃyamaṃ caraṇameva [caraṇaññeva (sī. syā. pī.)] saccaṃ.
segments.ja377:6.1: Na heva vedā aphalā bhavanti, sasaṃyamaṃ caraṇameva saccaṃ;
segments.ja377:6.3: Kittiñhi pappoti adhicca vede, santiṃ puṇeti [santaṃ pune’ti (sī. pī.)] caraṇena dantoti.
